english.title: Speeding - exceed 5 / 18 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 mph limit for a goods vehicle - manned equipment

(D)_[dual carriageway road,]_
(E)_[motorway,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to sections 86(1) and 89(1) of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive on a road a goods vehicle

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i)) Schedule 6 referred to in the wording of this offence wording runs to several pages. It is not reproduced within this database and should be referred to if there is any doubt about the wording of the charge.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wording: H4695 - relating to unmanned automatic equipment.
(iv) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied
